title: Auto Sneak & Sprint
description: A lightweight Forge client mod for toggle sneak, auto-sprint, HUD status display, and configurable movement options.
body:
ToggleSneak is a lightweight Forge client mod that adds toggle sneak and auto-sprint behavior for Minecraft.

Features:
- Toggle Sneak support
- Auto Sprint support
- Minimal HUD display for Sneak/Sprint status
- Forge Mods menu config screen
- Option to hide the HUD
- Option for the Sprint key to untoggle Sneak
- Optional creative-mode fly boost
- Configurable HUD position and display style

Default Controls:
- G: Sneak function enable/disable
- V: Sprint function enable/disable

Once the Sneak function is enabled, press your normal Sneak key to toggle sneaking on or off.

Once the Sprint function is enabled, sprinting is automatically engaged while moving forward.

Controls can be changed in Minecraft’s Controls menu under the ToggleSneak / Toggle Sneak&Sprint category. Settings can be changed from the Forge Mods menu config screen.

Source Code / More Versions:
https://github.com/MuddledGuy/ToggleSneak
